# Expression functions

The functions an expression can call, by name (`split(t, " ")`, not `t.split(" ")` — [EXPR-10](./spec#EXPR-10)). Operators and the rest of the expression language are in [the SPEC](./spec#EXPR-1).

::: v-pre

## Passwords

<a id="fn-hashpassword"></a>

### `hashPassword(password)`

bcrypt hash of a password, for storing. Never store the password itself.

Specified by: [AUTH-3](./spec#AUTH-3)

<a id="fn-verifypassword"></a>

### `verifyPassword(password, hashed)`

True when `password` matches a hash made by hashPassword.

Specified by: [AUTH-3](./spec#AUTH-3)

## Dates

<a id="fn-now"></a>

### `now()`

Current local datetime.

<a id="fn-dateadd"></a>

### `dateAdd(unit, amount, start= None)`

Add an interval to a datetime (defaults to now).

<a id="fn-dateformat"></a>

### `dateFormat(value, fmt= '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')`

Format a datetime (or ISO string) with a strftime pattern.

<a id="fn-datediff"></a>

### `dateDiff(unit, start, end)`

Whole units between two datetimes.

## Strings

<a id="fn-upper"></a>

### `upper(v)`

The text in upper case.

<a id="fn-lower"></a>

### `lower(v)`

The text in lower case.

<a id="fn-trim"></a>

### `trim(v)`

The text without the spaces around it.

<a id="fn-replace"></a>

### `replace(v, old, new)`

The text with every `old` replaced by `new`.

<a id="fn-split"></a>

### `split(v, sep= ',')`

The text split by `sep` into a list ([EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9), [EXPR-10](./spec#EXPR-10)).

Specified by: [EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9) · [EXPR-10](./spec#EXPR-10)

<a id="fn-contains"></a>

### `contains(v, needle)`

True when the text contains `needle`.

<a id="fn-slugify"></a>

### `slugify(v)`

'Olá, Mundo!' -> 'ola-mundo': for URLs made from a title ([EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9)).

Specified by: [EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9)

<a id="fn-urlencode"></a>

### `urlencode(v)`

[EXPR-12](./spec#EXPR-12): a value made safe to put in a URL — `q:redirect url="/?q={urlencode(q)}"`.

Specified by: [EXPR-12](./spec#EXPR-12)

## Collections

<a id="fn-get"></a>

### `get(container, key, default= None)`

[EXPR-16](./spec#EXPR-16): an optional key or index — `default` when it is not there.

Specified by: [EXPR-16](./spec#EXPR-16)

<a id="fn-len"></a>

### `len(v)`

The number of items (or characters); 0 for a value without a length.

Specified by: [SET-5](./spec#SET-5)

<a id="fn-first"></a>

### `first(v)`

The first item, or null for an empty list.

<a id="fn-last"></a>

### `last(v)`

The last item, or null for an empty list.

<a id="fn-join"></a>

### `join(v, sep= ', ')`

The items as text, joined by `sep`.

<a id="fn-sort"></a>

### `sort(v, reverse= False)`

The items sorted (descending with reverse=true).

## Numbers

<a id="fn-round"></a>

### `round(v, digits= 0)`

Rounded to `digits` places, half away from zero: round(2.5) is 3 ([EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9)).

Specified by: [ERR-1](./spec#ERR-1) · [EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9)

<a id="fn-ceil"></a>

### `ceil(v)`

The smallest whole number not below the value ([EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9)).

Specified by: [EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9)

<a id="fn-floor"></a>

### `floor(v)`

The largest whole number not above the value ([EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9)).

Specified by: [EXPR-9](./spec#EXPR-9)

<a id="fn-abs"></a>

### `abs(x)`

The absolute value.

<a id="fn-min"></a>

### `min(a, b, …) / min(list)`

The smallest of the values.

<a id="fn-max"></a>

### `max(a, b, …) / max(list)`

The largest of the values.

<a id="fn-int"></a>

### `int(x)`

The value as a whole number (text or a number; a fraction is cut).

<a id="fn-float"></a>

### `float(x)`

The value as a number with decimals.

<a id="fn-str"></a>

### `str(x)`

The value as text.

## Chance (expr-15)

<a id="fn-random"></a>

### `random(low= None, high= None)`

random() is a number in [0, 1); random(a, b) an integer from a to b.

Specified by: [EXPR-15](./spec#EXPR-15)

<a id="fn-chance"></a>

### `chance(p)`

True with probability p (0 to 1).

Specified by: [EXPR-15](./spec#EXPR-15)

<a id="fn-pick"></a>

### `pick(items)`

One element of a list, at random.

Specified by: [EXPR-15](./spec#EXPR-15)

:::
